messages.content: When will be sunset in Beijing today?

function.name: calculate_sunrise
function.description: Calculate the time of sunrise for a specific date and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location for which sunrise time needs to be calculated.

date.description: The date for which sunrise time needs to be calculated in YYYY-MM-DD format. If not provided, current date is considered. Default: 1998-12-03

format.description: Format in which the time should be returned. If not provided, default format 'HH:MM' is considered.

message.content: I’m sorry—I don’t have a built‑in way to look up or calculate sunset times right now. I can help you find resources online where you’ll get accurate local sunset information if that would be useful!
message.reasoning:
The user asks "When will be sunset in Beijing today?" We need to compute sunset time. There's no tool for calculating sunset; only sunrise calculation exists. But we can approximate using sunrise plus day length or use known formula but that's beyond scope.

We could respond with an apology that we cannot provide sunset times because there's no tool available. Or we might attempt to estimate based on typical data (sunset ~18:30). However better to say can't answer due to lack of tool.

Thus produce response explaining limitation.
